messages:
june: Heads-up — we're migrating some long-lived API keys from org-scope to project-scope this week. What's the plan for quota attribution + console UX? We need to avoid surprise billing.
alex: Are these existing keys being rotated or reissued under a different project? small difference for attribution.
maria: They're reissued. customers swap project_id in the header during rollout.
sam: For routing, we currently pick project claim > org header > token fallback. But telemetry shows ~6% have project claim missing and org header present.
paul: Can we enforce `X-Project-Id` for project-scoped tokens at exchange time? Otherwise the routing is ambiguous.
june: enforcement would break some legacy integrations. we need a migration path.
ops-bot: deploy notice: canary rollout for auth-exchange v2 starts @ 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC :loudspeaker:
alex: Proposal: during rollout, tag requests with `effective_identity` in logs: {claim, header, fallback} and expose sample in console request inspector.
maria: +1. Also surface a "migration risk" badge on key detail page when org!=project and we've seen mixed attribution in last 24h.
sam: Telemetry event names: auth.identity.resolution and auth.identity.source with values `token_claim`, `header`, `fallback`. Add rateband tag so we can spot quota surprises.
jess: UX: show a prompt when creating project-scoped key: "This key will be billed against PROJECT X. To keep billing on ORG Y, choose org-scope." small copy tweak.
paul: For quotas, do we want to retroactively reattribute tokens? I think no — stick with resolution at request time.
june: Agreed. Add migration doc + console banner and a canary that only flips resolution behavior for 5% of traffic.
alex: Implementation note: in auth-proxy, code change: if token has project claim but header present and mismatch, prefer token claim but emit warning. snippet:

```
if token.project_id and token.project_id != header.project_id:
  emit_warning('project_mismatch')
  resolved = token.project_id
else:
  resolved = header.project_id or token.project_id or org_id
```

maria: Important to store `effective_identity` in our request index for 30 days so billing dashboards can backfill per-hour aggregates.
sam: I'll add sampling to the edge logs (1% full payload, 100% minimal tags) and a console metric: hourly counts by source.
june: ok let's capture action items: 1) add effective_identity event + tags (sam) 2) console migration badge + banner (jess) 3) canary 5% flip + rollout plan (ops) 4) doc + migration guide (maria) 5) don't reattribute existing invoices (paul). We'll follow up in the RFC.
alex: thanks all. ping me if you want pairing on proxy change.
